parsed.explanation: The displayed dichotomy is not exhaustive: if V={c} for c>0, then neither g≡0 nor the stated mixed case with both 0 and c attainable holds. The later argument begins by assuming both values occur, so it does not formally cover this omitted branch. A sentence separating g≡c>0 as an immediate solution would repair this particular gap. The write-up should also explicitly derive g≥0 from positivity of the full arithmetic progression before asserting V⊆{0,c}.
